findings.title: New TableWidgetVisualization branch ignores query results and renders an empty table
findings.body: Inside tableResultComponent, when the organization has the `use-table-widget-visualization` feature, the code renders `<TableWidgetVisualization columns={[]} tableData={{data: [], meta: {fields: {}, units: {}}}}/>` instead of passing the actual `result` (its `data`/`meta`) that was fetched and used by the `StyledSimpleTableChart` path. This means any organization with the flag enabled will see completely blank table widgets on dashboards — columns and rows are hard-coded empty and the fetched `tableResults[i]` is discarded. The non-flag path still works, so this is a functional regression gated behind the flag; the new visualization should be fed `result.data`/`result.meta` (and the dataset's custom field renderers) rather than stub values.

findings.title: get_merged_pr_single_issue_template references PRCommentWorkflow._truncate_title from the wrong class
findings.body: `_truncate_title` and `get_merged_pr_single_issue_template` were both added as members of `CommitContextIntegration`, but the new staticmethod calls `PRCommentWorkflow._truncate_title(title)`. `_truncate_title` is defined on `CommitContextIntegration`, not on `PRCommentWorkflow` (a separate ABC that the GitHub/GitLab comment workflows derive from). Class-level access to `PRCommentWorkflow._truncate_title` will raise `AttributeError` at runtime when a merged-PR comment body is generated (the call is unconditional, even for short titles). It should reference the class the method lives on, e.g. `CommitContextIntegration._truncate_title(title)`.

findings.title: Null max_segment_id fix in _make_recording_filenames is not actually exercised
findings.body: The production fix in `src/sentry/replays/usecases/delete.py` adds an early `return []` in `_make_recording_filenames` when `row["max_segment_id"] is None`. The only test change here sets `"max_segment_id": None` in a mocked row, but `delete_matched_rows` (and therefore `delete_replay_recordings`/`_make_recording_filenames`) is fully patched out with `@patch("sentry.replays.tasks.delete_matched_rows")`, so the new null branch is never executed and there is no regression coverage for it. A direct unit test of `_make_recording_filenames` (returning `[]` for a None `max_segment_id`) is needed to validate the fix and catch future regressions.
